title: Vector command menu
statement: Process a sequence of vector-menu commands. R replaces the vector, S prints its sum, and M prints its maximum. Queries before the first read must print EMPTY.
input_format: The first line contains q (1 <= q <= 30). Each command is R followed by n and n integers, S, or M. Commands are case-insensitive.
output_format: For each S or M command print the result or EMPTY. Print INVALID for an unknown command.
